data.title: Top Dem senator says AI is contributing to outages as Rubio says incidents not connected
data.description: Sen. Mark Warner, D-Va., suggested on Tuesday that artificial intelligence is behind a series of outages across U.S. industries this week, but Secretary of State Marco Rubio insists there is "no evidence" the incidents are connected.
